title: Qman DirectPath Static admission business command
description: Closed public business command for requesting one Static admission attempt. The command identifies an already-persisted VM request but contains no caller-authored repository observation or authorization material.
x-qmanHashRule: commandHash is SHA-256 of CANONICAL-JSON-V1 over this complete command with commandHash represented as null.
x-qmanRequestRule: requestReference is business intent, not currentness proof. The repository must independently read the exact current persisted request and reject a version/hash mismatch inside its admission transaction.
x-qmanDeadlineRule: deadline is an exclusive business deadline. A repository uses its trusted clock and must not begin or commit a new admission at or after deadline.
x-qmanForbiddenCallerInputs: availability, lease, quarantine, inventory, policy, trust, catalog, or freshness observations
x-qmanAuthorityBoundary: The caller supplies only business identity and an immutable request reference. Every repository read set, current vector, CAS operand, lease identifier/specification, admission binding, resource version, and authority observation is derived and verified by the repository adapter; accepting any such caller-authored field is a contract violation.
